caption: A large bell in a tower is rung by a rope, and it swings back and forth with the clapper striking it on each swing.

sa.check: A large bell hangs in a tower.
A rope pulls it: the rope moves.
The bell swings back and forth.
The clapper strikes the bell on each swing.
Each pull of the rope precedes a swing.

pc.expect: The bell swings about its pivot as the rope moves; the rope and the bell move together.
pc.fail: The bell swings while the rope hangs slack and still for the whole clip; or the bell swings sideways across its pivot; or spins around its vertical axis; or the rope moves and the bell hangs dead still.

pc.expect: While the rope is pulled the arcs hold or grow; once the pulling stops the arcs shrink.
pc.fail: The arcs grow with the rope hanging slack; or the bell stops dead at the top of a swing; or the clapper stays pinned to the centre of the bell throughout while the bell swings.

pc.expect: The bell hangs below its pivot with its mouth down at rest; the clapper hangs down inside it.
pc.fail: The bell rests tilted with nothing holding it; or the clapper hangs upward; or the bell rises above its pivot and stays.

pc.expect: The clapper swings inside the bell, hits the rim and falls back.
pc.fail: The clapper hangs frozen against one side for the whole swing; or strikes the outside of the bell; or leaves the bell and swings outside it.

pc.expect: One bell with one clapper; a continuous rope; nothing passes through the bell or the beams.
pc.fail: A second bell appears; or the clapper vanishes; or the clapper passes through the bell wall; or the rope passes through the wheel or beams.

pc.expect: The bell's colour, the tower stones and the rope stay the same.
pc.fail: The bell changes colour; or the tower stones shift; or the rope changes colour.

note: Whoever pulls the rope is a trigger and is not judged.
